headline: 42.9% of homeowners paying more than minimum repayments
caption: Here's some encouraging news for East Auckland mortgage holders! New data shows that nearly 43% of Kiwis are already paying extra on their mortgages — and there are proven strategies to cut your interest bill significantly. If you're looking to reduce your mortgage faster and save thousands, we'd love to chat about how you can make your money work smarter. 🏡
original_title: How to cut your mortgage interest bill in half
